cards.title: The maze
cards.text: A square labyrinth, 24×24 squares. Dead ends hold chests; deeper ones are better.

parts.title: Sizes
parts.text: Corridors 6 cells wide (three of you side by side), walls 2 cells thick. The screen shows about 6×3 squares.

parts.title: Loops and halls
parts.text: A maze with many dead ends, plus 15% of walls knocked out so you can't be trapped forever, plus 4–6 open halls for big fights and bosses.

parts.title: Line of sight
parts.text: Simple, from your centre. Outside it is dark; walls you've seen stay faint. Enemies outside it are hidden, but close ones show a small tick at the screen edge.

parts.title: Chests
parts.text: At most dead ends. The longer the tunnel, the better the rarity. They glow through the dark within about 12 cells, so you notice side tunnels.

parts.title: Waves
parts.text: Enemies spawn out of sight, 20–35 cells away along the paths. Every minute adds more and new kinds. Hordes come down one corridor at set times.

parts.title: The exit
parts.text: Opens at 10:00 somewhere far away, shown on the minimap. Leave to bank all shards. Stay for a growing multiplier and a boss every 5 minutes. Dying banks half.

cards.title: Corridor width
cards.text: How wide are corridors, in player widths?
cards.why: Narrow corridors make a horde a wall and dead ends deadly. Wide ones give room to kite like Vampire Survivors.

options.label: 2 wide
options.text: 4 cells. Tight, every dead end is a trap.

options.label: 3 wide
options.text: 6 cells. Room to dodge one enemy. My pick.

options.label: 4 wide
options.text: 8 cells. Plenty of kiting room, less maze-like.

options.label: Mixed
options.text: Mostly 3, some 2-wide tunnels and 4-wide main roads.

cards.title: Hide unseen enemies
cards.text: Enemies outside your line of sight are fully hidden (with a small edge tick when close)?
cards.why: Hiding them makes the maze tense and corners scary. Showing them makes it fairer but the dark means less.

cards.title: Chest glow
cards.text: Chests glow through the dark when you're within about 12 cells?
cards.why: You wanted chests to make players explore. A glow says 'there's something down there' without a map marker.
cards.pick: Yes, a faint glow; seen chests stay on the minimap.

cards.title: When a run ends
cards.text: Exit opens at 10:00; stay for more until you die; dying banks half?
cards.why: It gives a clear goal, a greed choice, and keeps the endless survivor feel for those who want it.

cards.title: Your blasts and you
cards.text: Your own blasts never hurt you, but enemy Bomber blasts hurt enemies?
cards.why: Your maze doc says explosions hit everything. In a survivor game with blasts everywhere, hurting yourself would mean never picking Explode.
cards.pick: Yours never hurt you. Enemy blasts hit everything, you included.
